integrity: The proof gives an explicit weight-four construction and a matching lower bound from the bipartition structure, then forces both value-2 vertices to be the endpoints of one deleted matching edge. A standalone exhaustive checker independently tests all labelings in a nontrivial parameter range.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to crown graphs K_{n,n}-M with n at least three.
No formula is claimed for arbitrary regular bipartite graphs or for partial matching deletions.
Full-label exhaustive verification is performed only for 3 <= n <= 7 and is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed crown-graph treatment.
title: Perfect Roman domination of crown graphs
